scope: Peaceful instrumentation and integration development experiment. This protocol does not establish completion of work package B, C, sustained learning, retention, or open multistage capability.
sourceIdentityQualification: Pins were read from the existing stopped-run provenance and earlier matched registrations. Rehash source bytes and verify each new fork before launch, after the current no-CPU interval ends. Do not copy an already-mutated R4/R5 runtime.
secondsScope: The existing evaluator deadline includes native startup; retain actual elapsed time and overruns.
pinRule: Before the first launch, retain this registration's byte SHA and write a separate launch-pins record with source commit, complete source/build/harness/dependency identities, full-gate command/log/exit status, frozen manifest SHA, registered source/world/session/goal byte checks, and both restored initial model digests. Null fields mean no candidate has been approved by completed software evidence yet, not a wildcard actor. Both conditions must use the same frozen files. Do not execute the changing checkout.
pairedConditionEligibility: The frozen condition follows the archived and independently audited first online development run. A failed integrity check blocks claims and dependent launch until a new source revision is separately registered. A refusal-heavy or unsupported but intact online run remains a negative development result and is not itself a reason to rerun or change the fixed frozen condition.
initialStateRule: Each condition forks the same original smoke world and session bytes, preserving original choices, tasks and nonlearning state. Frozen does not start from the online outcome. The candidate may initialize explicitly versioned empty continuous components and reset live epoch/h on restore, but it must preserve legacy knowledge under its original semantics; record any representation-digest change and prove equality between conditions before launch. No old clock is reconstructed and no old certificate is assigned to new interval dynamics.
intervention: Add actual per-frame physical clocks and sampled anonymous motor state, actual press/release edges, bounded opt-in ordered delivery, and one real frame-state owner shared by passive, action and refused paths. Real z assimilation proceeds with learning enabled or frozen. Only complete validated original experience windows may write theta when learning is enabled. New interval rows remain subordinate to the original event identity.
unchanged: original initial stopped world, player data, session bytes, choice state, and goal
32 new decisions and the 180-second existing evaluator bound in each condition
original 100/50 ms native planning deadlines, node budgets, support thresholds and independent-window counts
autonomous action selection, existing action holds, stabilization and return behavior
one action preparation and at most one requested-50-ms next-frame wait per decision, exact full-frame sequence/SHA guard, no retry
one postplanning passive drain before preparation; any later preceding passive learning still finishes before the fresh forecast
all real refusals, incomplete windows, missing traces, overflows, clock faults, unsupported outputs and deaths remain in the denominator

clocked frames, zero-tick terminal samples, held/off/unknown intervals, gaps, lost records/frames/edges, absent boundaries and missing state traces
live state revision and consumed frame watermark; initial setup-anchor surplus and checkpoint/close tail separately
initial/final theta learning digests and writes; new fitted interval counts versus original independent window counts

instrumentationDecisionRule: A complete 32-decision run with reconciled actual frames, consistent clocks/edges, truthful live watermarks and no missing trace/queue loss can support correct recorded integration in this development sample. A stopped partial sample is incomplete. Legacy clocks or missing required instrumentation are unsupported. Contradictory data fail. Unknown/unexercised held control or terminal cases remain unexercised, not passed native subclaims. Neither execution rate nor audit success establishes a useful learned predictor.
plasticityDecisionRule: For frozen, theta/affordance learning digest must remain exactly unchanged and the real live state must assimilate actual frames. For online, report whether new validated original windows write theta and whether its digest changes. If no learning occurs, report that negative result; do not force training, erase knowledge, manufacture independent windows or rerun. Changed theta alone is not beneficial learning, and differing final z across the two changing trajectories is not a paired causal state test.
auditorLimits: The independent frame-state script imports no actor and performs no learner/model readout; it checks source clocks, motor samples, receipt identity and consumption accounting.

Current decision.live counters do not independently reconstruct every accepted z or prove the state used for a forecast. Software tests and source review supply that separate evidence; any stronger native claim requires pre-recorded exact state/frame bindings.
The complete transport order-to-frame map is not journaled. Source sample-before-release evidence does not become proof of all main-thread delivery order.
Cached setup anchors are real assimilation anchors, not newly learned windows. The unarchived checkpoint/close tail is not credited as consumed/learned experience.
The old R4/R5 comparison is legacy for the new physical-clock/live audit. It must report unsupported rather than pass B.
remainingNecessaryGates: B: measure and learn physical held/off intervals with one original-window owner, then precompute a private rollout timeline from the true start state; do not use teacher-forced intermediate frames or final actual duration as prior inputs

B: preserve real body return semantics; separately support release time, uncertain stabilization/return horizon and conservative action-end envelope. Unknown return horizon must withdraw complete action-end support

B: verify native cue/occlusion history and real different consequences; compare full state with history erased, intermediate frames omitted, and actual motor timing erased under separately registered matched conditions

C: independent same-world frozen/erased/online retention, a perceptibly different B mechanism and exact return to A; require useful supported prediction/task benefit rather than parameter changes alone

causal composition: unseen real prerequisite combinations, actual dependence on earlier observed effects, later distinct-frame goal confirmation and appropriate matched controls without supplied routes/stages

sustained learning: independently registered 1/8/24-hour evidence with bounded resources, retained raw failures, useful retention and open multistage outcomes; finite smoke integration cannot substitute
originalProtocolPreserved: The already registered original-world 256 decisions/1800 seconds acquisition followed by erased-frozen, retained-online and retained-frozen comparisons at 192 decisions/480 seconds remains unchanged. This smoke-start B integration pair neither replaces those results nor adds decisions to them.
